title: ApexVoid Configuration V3
description: Schema for the normalized, fully-merged (includes + environment overlay resolved) Configuration V3 document — NOT a schema for config/apexvoid.yml as a standalone file (that file is just {version, includes}; see rootDocument below for that narrower shape) but for what a loader produces after resolving includes + overlay. See docs/configuration-v3-migration-audit.md and docs/configuration.md.

version.description: §18 — exactly 3; a loader must refuse any other value, no best-effort forward compatibility.

environment.description: §13 — the selected environment; must match one of config/environments/*.yml (minus the .yml suffix). Not a free string once a loader exists: the loader validates it against the actual overlay files present.

depth.description: Stored MarketHistory depth per timeframe (candles) — not any algorithm's calculation lookback.

rootDocument.description: config/apexvoid.yml itself, before includes/overlay are resolved.

includes.description: §14 — paths relative to config/, no absolute escape; a loader must error on a missing/duplicate/cyclic include.
